Key Finding: Perceived usefulness and ease of use strongly shape whether users adopt an information system.
APA Reference: Davis, F. D. (1989). Perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and user acceptance of information technology. MIS Quarterly, 13(3), 319-340. https://doi.org/10.2307/249008

Key Finding: Acceptance depends on usefulness, ease of use, social influence, and facilitating conditions.
APA Reference: Venkatesh, V., Morris, M. G., Davis, G. B., & Davis, F. D. (2003). User acceptance of information technology. MIS Quarterly, 27(3), 425-478. https://doi.org/10.2307/30036540

Key Finding: Intention is shaped by attitude, perceived norms, and perceived behavioral control.
APA Reference: Ajzen, I. (1991). The theory of planned behavior. Organizational Behavior and Human Decision Processes, 50(2), 179-211. https://doi.org/10.1016/0749-5978(91)90020-T

Key Finding: AAL2 requires higher-confidence, often two-factor authentication for sensitive digital services.
APA Reference: Temoshok, D., et al. (2025). NIST SP 800-63B-4: Digital identity guidelines. NIST. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-63B-4

Key Finding: Access control should verify function- and data-level authorization for every protected request.
APA Reference: OWASP Foundation. (2019). OWASP application security verification standard 4.0.3. OWASP. https://owasp.org/www-project-application-security-verification-standard/

Key Finding: Identity proofing should use risk-based evidence and lifecycle controls before binding a digital identity.
APA Reference: Temoshok, M., et al. (2025). NIST SP 800-63A-4: Enrollment and identity proofing. NIST. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.SP.800-63A-4

Key Finding: Mobile money use can sustain higher consumption and reduce household poverty over time.
APA Reference: Suri, T., & Jack, W. (2016). The long-run poverty and gender impacts of mobile money. Science, 354(6317), 1288-1292. https://doi.org/10.1126/science.aah5309

Key Finding: Digital payments can improve resilience and access to financial services, especially for underserved users.
APA Reference: World Bank. (2022). Global Findex 2021. World Bank. https://doi.org/10.1596/978-1-4648-1897-4

Key Finding: Mobile money can reduce the cost of risk sharing by enabling low-cost peer-to-peer transfers.
APA Reference: Jack, W., & Suri, T. (2014). Risk sharing and transactions costs. American Economic Review, 104(1), 183-228. https://doi.org/10.1257/aer.104.1.183

Key Finding: Real-time or frequent electricity feedback can reduce consumption when usage is made visible.

Key Finding: Social-norm home-energy reports can create measurable and persistent conservation effects.

Key Finding: Nonpecuniary behavioral interventions can reduce resource use with low-cost feedback and norms.

Key Finding: The Philippine Data Privacy Act regulates lawful processing, security, accountability, and data-subject rights.
APA Reference: Republic of the Philippines. (2012). Republic Act No. 10173: Data Privacy Act of 2012. https://privacy.gov.ph/data-privacy-act/

Key Finding: Personal-information controllers must establish purpose, proportionality, security, and accountable processing.

APA Reference: National Institute of Standards and Technology. (2020). NIST Privacy Framework 1.0. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.CSWP.10

Key Finding: Privacy principles require purpose limitation, proportional collection, security, and data-subject safeguards.
APA Reference: Organisation for Economic Co-operation and Development. (2013). OECD privacy guidelines. OECD. https://doi.org/10.1787/9789264196391-en

Key Finding: Data minimization and purpose-focused system design reduce avoidable harm and operational privacy risk.
APA Reference: National Institute of Standards and Technology. (2020). NIST Privacy Framework 1.0. https://doi.org/10.6028/NIST.CSWP.10

Key Finding: Technology professionals should prioritize human welfare, privacy, honesty, and stakeholder accountability.
APA Reference: Association for Computing Machinery. (2018). ACM code of ethics and professional conduct. ACM. https://www.acm.org/code-of-ethics
